acceptance: DOMAIN_NODE_KINDS and DOMAIN_NODE_KIND_SPECS include DataSource and Field with closed deterministic metadata schemas while every previously qualified node/edge kind remains compatible.
DataSource metadata cannot be interpreted as proof that a source was connected, reachable, authenticated, read, or synchronized.
Field metadata cannot grant entity ownership, storage, classification, or mapping authority merely because the node exists.
Focused tests prove valid examples plus missing-required, unknown-field, wrong-type, deterministic issue ordering, and full canonical domain-validation compatibility.

The exact implementation candidate must pass repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline at the truthful risk tier, checksum-verified Alibaba Open Code Review, Jev semantic review when credentialed, exact-head CI, normal merge, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused DataSource/Field metadata-contract tests plus full repository format/lint/typecheck/test suites.
Diffcipline proof, Alibaba OCR review evidence, Jev review evidence when credentialed, exact-head semantic review, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: Canonical dataset relations require DataSource and Field node endpoints. Adding only those endpoint contracts before relation semantics avoids wildcard/string-reference authority and keeps relation validation independently reviewable.

requirements: DataSource metadata never grants network, credential, read, synchronization, or persistence capability.
Field metadata never grants entity ownership, classification, storage, or mapping authority.
No endpoint metadata may be treated as evidence that an external source or stored field exists at runtime.

outcome: The Product Graph can represent DataSource and Field as closed deterministic metadata nodes, providing typed endpoints required by canonical dataset relations without using string-reference authority or wildcard substitutes.
rationale: SG-000034 and SG-000035 established Dataset-family metadata nodes. Canonical S07 relations require DataSource and Field endpoints that do not yet exist in the qualified domain-v1 vocabulary, so these endpoint contracts must be introduced before relation authority can be added safely.

risk.recovery: Revert the DataSource and Field node-kind/spec additions and their focused tests; canonical Dataset-family metadata through SG-000035 remains intact.

scope_in: Add a closed DataSource Product Graph node contract that records human-inspectable source identity/type plus provenance and optional environment/status/verification metadata without opening a connection or reading data.

Add a closed Field Product Graph node contract that records human-inspectable field name/type plus provenance and optional description/status/verification metadata without claiming storage, entity ownership, classification, or mapping relations.
Extend the existing deterministic node validator and focused tests only; preserve all previously qualified node and edge kinds unchanged.

Use these node kinds only as typed prerequisites for the later S07 relation Grain covering BINDS_TO, VERSION_OF, PRODUCES, MAPS_TO, DESCRIBES, VALIDATES, SUPPORTS, and relevant field classification semantics.
scope_out: No new edge kind, endpoint pair, cross-node existence rule, relation widening, source read, database/API connection, network access, secret access, persistence mutation, Supabase operation, model/provider call, import execution, profiling, mapping execution, quality-rule execution, generation, or environment write.
No P02-S06 Component/Feature/ProductRevision/DeploymentTarget repair, no ProductCompletenessManifest, no VectorCorpus/EvalDataset, and no P03 work.
title: IN-P02-S07-T01C DataSource and Field relation endpoint contracts
